common.title: Cinder Shift 64
menu.context: The isolation protocol has locked down Caldera 7. Prepare Mira and restore a route through the sectors to the evacuation platform.
menu.noSave: No saved shift. Start with one research point.
menu.preview: One playable mission · three rooms. This is the end of the available preview.
results.newCampaignsUnlocked: New campaigns unlocked: Small World and Adriatic Signal.
results.unlockSaveFailed: The final result could not be saved, so the new worlds are still locked. Retry the save before leaving this result.
challenge.title: Caldera trials
challenge.context: Run self-contained missions with Mira’s base suit. Challenge records never alter your campaign.
challenge.deviceUtcDate: Daily schedule uses this device’s UTC date: {date}
challenge.storageUnavailable: Local record storage is unavailable. You can still play; this run will not overwrite saved records.
challenge.readyText: The clock starts after the suit and room are ready.
challenge.eligibility.practice: Practice result · excluded from Standard records
challenge.notSaved: This result could not be saved on this device.
challenge.codeInvalid: This code is invalid or uses an unsupported setup.
challenge.codeCreated: Challenge code ready. Share it with the other player.
challenge.codeManualCopy: Clipboard is unavailable. The code is selected for manual copying.
challenge.resultUnverified: Result from code · not independently verified
challenge.relaySupportContext: Stage A is complete. Your collected relay intel unlocks one support package for the Cargo stage. The next player starts with full integrity.
challenge.relayIntelContext: A sealed data shard is cached in this protected service pocket. Collecting it is optional and does not consume the repair or salvage choice.
challenge.supportNeedsIntel: Collect the relay intel to choose POWER or REPAIR.
challenge.relayCodeCreated: Handoff code ready. Share it or continue to Stage B.
challenge.relayReceiptAccepted: Relay response accepted and linked to its handoff.
challenge.relaySolo: Both stages were completed on this device.
challenge.relayShared: Stage results are linked by the handoff code; they are not a verified one-shot team run.
challenge.relayRepairContext: Use this separate cache once after collecting the energy cell. It does not consume the standard R02 repair.
challenge.scoreBreakdown: Score breakdown · victory {victory}, optional goals {optional_goals}, walkers {walkers}, drones {drones}, turrets {turrets}, time {time_bonus}, clean run {clean_bonus}.
challenge.leaderboardUnavailable: Portal leaderboard unavailable for this build ({status}). Local play and records remain available.
challenge.medalPendingCalibration: Medals will appear after reference times are calibrated in playtests.
menu.replaceText: The current shift, research and rewards will be replaced. Language and control settings stay.
menu.restartText: Room positions are not saved. Continue starts a fresh attempt with the same entry loadout and event plan, full integrity and zero score.
privacy.title: Analytics preferences
privacy.description: Allow visit and gameplay statistics for Nuts Games? You can play without analytics and change this choice at any time.
privacy.unset: Analytics are off until you allow them.
research.title: Suit workshop
research.context: Inspect a module, then confirm the purchase. You may keep your point and deploy with the base suit.
research.W1.name: Splitter
research.W1.effect: Fire three projectiles in a fan. Catch several targets with one shot.
research.M1.name: Ground impulse
research.M1.effect: A short ground dash. Recharges in 3 s; walls stop the suit.
research.D1.name: Reinforced frame
research.D1.effect: Suit integrity 6 → 8. Each attempt starts at full HP.
research.W3.name: Ricochet core
research.W3.effect: Reflect one shot from a marked ricochet panel.
research.W4.name: Capacitor shot
research.W4.effect: Active shot deals 4 damage and recharges in 5 s. Uses the active slot.
research.M3.name: Magnetic traverse
research.M3.effect: During an active dash, the suit can pass through marked walls.
research.M4.name: Phase circuit
research.M4.effect: During a dash, pass through marked energy curtains. Ordinary walls still stop the suit.
research.D3.name: Discharge pulse
research.D3.effect: When the room buffer absorbs a hit, it also clears enemy projectiles.
research.D4.name: Reserve section
research.D4.effect: Once per mission, survive lethal damage at up to 2 integrity.
research.confirmText: Purchase {node} for 1 point? It applies to the next mission entry.
mission.name: Airlock
mission.goal: Restore the emergency line and leave
mission.route: A — suit check. B — service corridor. C — power cabinet and evacuation airlock. Robots may be bypassed.
mission.retryRule: After death, retry restores the entry loadout and the same event plan.
mission.conditionClosed: E02 · Upper maintenance route closed in B. The ground passage remains open to every suit.
mission.repairSlot: R01 · After both threat sections, a protected service pocket offers up to 2 HP. E03 changes this same slot to a choice of repair or salvage.
mission.objective.power: Restore the emergency line in room C
mission.objective.corridor: Cross the corridor. Cover blocks fire; the upper shelf changes firing height.
mission.objective.closed: Upper route locked. Cross below the shutter; cover still blocks fire.
mission.objective.hold: Hold {action} for {seconds} s to restore power
events.title: E03 / Repair cache
events.context: E03 changes the R01 service cache after both threat sections. Choose up to 2 HP or 150 salvage score; this replaces the repair.
events.full: Integrity is full — no repair needed
events.once: One claim per attempt. No research points are awarded.
events.beaconContext: At S04, choose a preview of the next room or restore 1 missing HP. This cache does not award the usual salvage score.
events.salvageContext: Optional pickup. Collect 150 salvage score; it does not change access to the navigation data.
events.patrolContext: The marked S05 pocket is voluntary. Activating the patrol adds one preset ram; defeat it to earn 250 salvage score. You can leave without taking the risk.
repair.title: {slot} / Service repair
repair.context: The protected service pocket is beyond both threat sections. Restore up to 2 integrity; unused repair is not stored.
repair.once: One repair slot for this mission. Full integrity leaves the slot available.
results.reward: First victory in this mission: +1 research point
results.noReward: This mission grants no additional research point.
results.deathReward: No research points for a failed attempt. Retry keeps the entry loadout and event plan.
results.campaignCheckpoint: The Archive chapter is complete. Its data opens the route to the Reactor; this campaign branch currently ends at a checkpoint.
results.campaignEnd: All five sectors are complete. Mira reached the evacuation platform.
results.bestScore: Best campaign score for this content build: {score}
results.noBestScore: No completed campaign record exists for this content build yet.
results.recordPending: The campaign record is not stored yet. It will retry when you reopen this result.
results.partialHistory: Some history from before this content version could not be reconstructed.
results.assisted: This campaign used longer enemy warning times.
settings.title: Suit settings
settings.autofireHint: Auto-fire uses the same weapon effect and only targets visible enemies in front of the suit.
settings.combatAssistHint: Enemy attack warnings last 50% longer. Campaign records are marked Assisted.
settings.rebindConflict: That key is already assigned to another action.
settings.controls.keyboard: {left}/{right}: move · {jump}: jump · {crouch}: crouch · {fire}: fire · {interact}: interact · {ability}: active skill · {pause}: pause
settings.controls.touch: Left: movement and crouch. Right: jump, fire and interaction. Impulse appears only when equipped.
settings.controls.gamepad: Stick/D-pad: move · A: jump/confirm · RT: fire · X: interact · B: impulse/back in menus · Menu: pause
settings.navigation: Menus: Tab or arrows to select · Enter/Space to confirm · Esc to go back. Gamepad: D-pad, A and B.
settings.telemetry: Gameplay statistics are sent only with analytics consent. Diagnostics stay in this tab.
pause.title: Pause
pause.manual: World and sound are paused. Resume explicitly when ready.
pause.blur: The window lost focus. World, timers and sound are paused.
pause.hidden: The tab is in the background. World, timers and sound are paused.
pause.portrait: Rotate your phone to landscape. Then resume explicitly.
pause.save: Continue after a reload returns to the mission entrance with the same loadout and events.
training.note: TRAINING · no campaign progress or rewards
errors.title: Restart required
errors.load: Resources could not be loaded. Reload to try again.
errors.context: The browser lost the graphics context. Reload returns to the mission entrance if saving is available.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.save.unavailable: Storage is unavailable. This shift works in memory; closing or reloading may lose progress.
errors.save.write_failed: Saving failed. The current shift continues in memory; progress is not safely stored.
errors.save.corrupt: The saved shift is damaged. It has not been erased. Start a new shift only after confirming replacement.
errors.save.incompatible: This save uses an unsupported version. It has not been erased. Reset the shift explicitly to play this version.
errors.save.unknown_nodes: The save contains unknown research modules. Progress is kept; confirm replacement to start a new shift.
errors.resetText: This replaces only campaign progress. Language, sound and control settings stay.
accessibility.game: Game field. Controls are available in Settings.
accessibility.fps: Frame rate over the last minute
meta.description: Cinder Shift 64 — a playable emergency shift on Caldera 7. Nuts Games.
errors.save.replaceUnknown: Storage cannot be read right now. Starting a new shift may replace an earlier save when saving becomes available. Start a new shift?
character.title: Choose an operator
character.mira.name: Mira Wei
character.portrait: Mira in the equipped engineering suit
character.context: Mira is ready for the emergency shift. Other operators will become available later.
workshop.nextEntry: Modules apply on the next mission entry. Viewing modules does not spend research points.
workshop.spreadNote: Three projectiles: straight and at ±10°. Spread does not guarantee three hits. Projectile damage and fire rate stay the same.
workshop.dash: Ground dash: up to {distance} px in {seconds} s; cooldown {cooldown} s. No extra invulnerability.
workshop.salvage: Optional salvage score: {score}. It is separate from research points; bypassing robots is allowed.
workshop.deathHint.drone: Change height or take cover before the drone fires. Retry restores full integrity with the same loadout and conditions.
workshop.deathHint.walker: Use cover or crouch under the walker fire. Retry keeps the entry loadout and event plan.
workshop.deathHint.unknown: Watch the warning and use cover. Retry keeps the entry loadout and restores full integrity.
audio.title: Audio mixer
audio.unavailable: Some sounds are unavailable. The shift remains playable.
research.W2.name: Piercer
research.W2.effect: Normal shots pass through one light target or a marked thin sheet.
research.M2.name: Air jets
research.M2.effect: Use the dash in midair with the same shared recharge.
research.D2.name: Emergency buffer
research.D2.effect: Absorbs the first hit in each room. Revisiting does not refill it.
cargo.name: Cargo sector
cargo.goal: Collect the energy cell and install it in the switchboard
cargo.route: Receiving bay → transport line → cell storage → switchboard.
cargo.conditionOff: E01 · The late turret in F starts offline and its short upper passage is blocked. The lower route and energy cell remain accessible.
cargo.conditionNone: No E01 event. E’s teaching turret remains powered; the short passage in F is open and its late turret stays offline.
cargo.objective.cell: Find the energy cell in storage.
cargo.objective.install: Cell collected. Install it in the switchboard.
cargo.objective.exit: Sector power restored. Use the exit on the right.
cargo.objective.take: Press {action} to collect the energy cell.
cargo.objective.restore: Press {action} to open the short passage and power the late turret.
mission.subtitle.D: Security walkers pursue. Cover breaks their line of sight.
mission.subtitle.E: The teaching turret is always powered. Watch its longer first cycle from cover.
mission.subtitle.F: E01 changes only the late turret and short upper passage. The lower route and cell stay accessible.
mission.subtitle.G: A security walker and a turret guard separate lanes. The cell is required at the switchboard.
map.title: Caldera 7 map
map.context: Mira’s route through the complex. Inspecting a node changes neither progress nor position.
map.foundryGoal: Stop the assembly line using two terminals.
map.archiveGoal: Retrieve navigation data and open transit.
foundry.conditionHeat: E04 may activate on the Press route. The heat lane signals its danger cycle in advance; the Service route remains open.
foundry.conditionNone: E04 heat is not scheduled for this attempt. After terminal 1, choose Service or Press.
archive.conditionBeacon: E05 changes S04: choose a preview of 04C or +1 missing HP. The usual salvage score is not awarded.
archive.conditionNone: S04 awards 150 salvage score. The turret and aggressive walker are further ahead in the Data Hall.
foundry.fork.title: Foundry / choose a route
foundry.fork.context: Terminal 1 isolated the feed. Choose one branch; both rejoin at the cooling loop and R03.
foundry.fork.serviceBody: Longer and calmer. A passive walker comes before a drone; no press or heat hazard.
foundry.fork.pressBody: Shorter and riskier. Read the press cycle first; salvage score is optional.
foundry.subtitle.M3A: The ram lane is marked ahead. Disable the feed first.
foundry.subtitle.M3B: The longer bypass separates the walker and drone with cover.
foundry.subtitle.M3C: Watch the press cycle. E04 heat has a separate shelter.
foundry.subtitle.M3D: R03 is in the protected pocket before the final platform.
foundry.objective.line: Stop the line at both terminals.
foundry.objective.terminal: Defeat the threat, then activate terminal 1.
foundry.objective.route: Choose the Service bypass or Press corridor.
foundry.objective.press: Read the press windows and cross to the cooling loop.
foundry.objective.heat: Watch the heat signal. The shelter is on the left.
reactor.subtitle.M5A: Two threats cover different lanes. The marked curtain can be crossed during a dash with M4.
reactor.subtitle.M5B: Read the heat warning from cover. S05 is an optional risk when E06 is scheduled.
reactor.subtitle.M5C: A safe repair and a clear view of the arena. No enemies or hazards enter here.
reactor.subtitle.M5D: The Regulator exposes its core only between marked attack cycles.
reactor.subtitle.M5E: The complex is quiet. Reach the evacuation platform.
reactor.objective.blockade: Destroy the outer shield target, then open the route.
reactor.objective.transit: The outer shield is down. Continue to the thermal collector.
reactor.objective.heat: Read the heat cycle and cross to the service camera.
reactor.objective.patrol: S05 is optional. E06 adds a ram only if you activate the patrol.
reactor.objective.patrolChoice: Press {action} to accept the optional E06 patrol.
reactor.objective.patrolActive: E06 patrol is active. Defeat the ram for 250 salvage score, or leave it behind.
reactor.objective.service: R05 can restore up to 2 integrity. Then inspect the arena and enter.
reactor.objective.boss: Integrity {hp}. Amber marks a beam warning; red marks its active lane.
reactor.objective.bossDown: Regulator disabled. The evacuation door is open.
reactor.objective.evacuation: Reach the evacuation platform to finish the campaign.
archive.subtitle.M4A: A quiet stretch. One passive walker patrols the machine line.
archive.subtitle.M4B: S04 is optional and sits away from the required exit.
archive.subtitle.M4C: An aggressive walker and turret cover separate lanes. R04 opens after upload.
archive.subtitle.M4D: A ram controls the lower lane. Look for cover and an alternate position.
archive.objective.data: Retrieve navigation data and open transit.
archive.objective.sorting: Open access to the navigation archive.
archive.objective.cache: Optional S04 is nearby. You can keep moving.
archive.objective.beacon: Choose a preview of the next room or +1 HP.
archive.objective.beaconChoice: Press {action} to choose the E05 beacon payload.
archive.objective.upload: Hold the action at the terminal to upload the data.
archive.objective.scouted: Recon confirms the walker and turret cover separate lanes.
archive.objective.holdUpload: Hold {action} for {seconds} s to upload the data.
archive.objective.transit: Data uploaded. R04 is available before transit.
archive.objective.exit: Use the data and reach the exit on the right.
map.reactorGoal: Disable the Regulator and reach the evacuation platform.
map.reactorRoute: 05A outer shield → 05B thermal collector → 05C service camera → 05D Regulator → 05E evacuation. E06 adds only an optional patrol.
map.evacuation: Final destination: the evacuation platform beyond the Reactor. It is not a sixth mission.
results.airlockExit: The Airlock leads deeper into the complex. Restore power in the Cargo sector next.
repair.r02Context: After the energy cell, a shielded pocket offers one repair of up to 2 integrity before the switchboard. Full integrity leaves R02 unused.
cargo.objective.turretHint: Turret armor open — fire now to damage it.
rework.repairFull: Repair not needed — integrity is full
rework.activeIdle: Purchased · select in the active slot
arrival.title: CALDERA COMPLEX
arrival.description: A shuttle docks at an industrial complex. Mira disembarks as an emergency alarm begins.
arrival.approach: Approach confirmed. Docking at the outer airlock.
arrival.disembark: Mira Vey, on site. Restore the transit power.
arrival.emergency: Emergency lockdown. Reach the Regulator and open an evacuation route.
rework.evacuationComplete: Evacuation complete. The complex is shut down. Review your shift results.
